question: Who is the author of the famous novel ‘Chokher Bali’?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rabindranath Tagore.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__****Chokher Bali**

__
 
• ​Chokher Bali is a Bengali Novel authored by **Ravindra Nath Tagore in the 20th century.**
 
• The novel highlights issues like **Women's Education, Child marriage, Deplorable Position of women in Indian society before independence.**
 
• The novel also reflects the pitiful **Plight of Widows.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**** Bankim Chandra Chatterjee**

 
• Bankim Chandra Chatterjee (27 June 1838–8 April 1894) was an **Indian novelist, poet, and journalist.**
 
• **Durgeshnandini** is a Bengali historical romance novel written by Indian writer Bankim Chandra Chattopadhyay in 1865.
 
• **He was the composer of Vande Mataram, originally in Sanskrit**, personifying India as a mother goddess and inspiring activists during the Indian Independence Movement.
 
• He wrote fourteen novels and many serious, seriocomic, satirical, scientific, and critical treatises in Bengali.
 
• He is known as Sahitya Samrat (Emperor of Literature) in Bengali.

**Munshi Premchand**

 
• He was an Indian writer famous for his modern **Hindustani literature.**
 
• Munshi Premchand is one of the most celebrated writers of the Indian subcontinent and is regarded as one of the foremost Hindi writers of the early twentieth century.
 
• **He published his first collection of five short stories in 1907 in a book called Soz-e Watan.**
 
• He began writing under the pen name "Nawab Rai", but subsequently switched to "Premchand", Munshi being an honorary prefix.
